BrochureContent.Content:
Situated in the popular Retreat Road Manor development in Athlone, Co. Westmeath, No. 8 is a bright and spacious first-floor apartment offering modern, comfortable living.

The property features a large open-plan living and dining area, two generous sized double bedrooms and a well-finished bathroom. It benefits from electric heating, private parking and access to a large communal green area.

Ideally located, residents can enjoy excellent amenities within 500 metres walking distance including three secondary schools, primary schools, two shopping centres and the train station. The A1 bus line also serves the area, offering easy commuting to workplaces such as Ericsson and other major employers. This property is perfect for first-time buyers, downsizers or investors seeking a convenient and well-connected home.
